answer.rationale: With expiry in 14 days and the line at 94% of committed volume, incumbent renewal is the only currently evidenced path that avoids introducing migration and delivery-interruption risk. The low-cost vendor’s prior cost and onboarding performance merit verification, but the inherited record does not establish equivalent delivery reliability under current no-buffer conditions. This preserves continuity while explicitly flagging that the incumbent’s refusal to reopen price leaves the 18% spend-cut mandate unmet and requires follow-on action at the next review.
